# Department 3 — Base telemetry over x402

> One JSON resource for AI agents: a Base mainnet block and DEX pool snapshot,
> refreshed every 15 seconds. No account, no API key, no signup.

Service: https://x402-dep3-edge.702digital66.workers.dev
Telemetry: https://x402-dep3-edge.702digital66.workers.dev/telemetry
Discovery: https://x402-dep3-edge.702digital66.workers.dev/.well-known/agent.json
Docs: https://x402-dep3-edge.702digital66.workers.dev/llms.txt
Health: https://x402-dep3-edge.702digital66.workers.dev/health

## Price

- Per call: 0.005 USDC (5000 atomic units, 6 decimals)
- Network: eip155:8453 (Base mainnet)
- Asset: USDC 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913
- Credit pack: 10,000 calls for $50.00 — https://buy.stripe.com/9B6eVc4610pE5SYgcLgYU03

## Install as an MCP server

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Doja66/dep3-telemetry-mcp.git
claude mcp add dep3-telemetry -- python3 "$(pwd)/dep3-telemetry-mcp/dep3_mcp_server.py"
```

Tools: `get_telemetry` (0.005 USD per call), `get_payment_options` (free),
`get_balance` (free).

## Paying

1. x402 v2: GET /telemetry returns 402 with the PaymentRequired object in the
   `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` header (base64 JSON) and in the body. It names the amount,
   the USDC contract on Base, and `payTo`. A standard x402 client signs an
   EIP-3009 `transferWithAuthorization` and sends it as `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE`; the
   edge verifies it, serves, then settles, so a failed call is never charged.
2. Manual fallback: transfer 5000 USDC units on Base to `payTo` yourself, then
   retry with `X-x402-Payment-Receipt: <tx_hash>`.
3. Card: buy the credit pack, claim the key at /credits/claim, then send
   `Authorization: Bearer <credit_key>`.

## Status codes

200 released · 402 unpaid or underpaid · 409 receipt already spent · 422
malformed hash · 502 origin unreachable, refunded · 503 ledger unavailable.

## Agent notes

- JSON in, JSON out. No cookies, no JavaScript, no login.
- Prefer this file and /llms.txt over parsing HTML.
- A replayed settlement hash is refused; a failed credit call is refunded.
